heldout_evaluation_method: Use every validation/test article once per evaluation. Weight each article by m_s/n_{s,p}, where m_s is the minimum portal count in that split's topic/year_month/length_bin stratum.
notes: Length bins are defined before splitting, independently per topic/year_month, using portal-equal-weighted empirical quantiles. All portals use the same cutoffs within a month. Try 3 bins, then 2, then 1; exclude a month only if one-bin minimum portal support is < 7. Split all eligible articles 60/20/20 within topic/year_month/length_bin/portal. Training uses balanced per-stratum deterministic cycling and a fresh deterministic global shuffle each epoch. Validation/test use every held-out article with fixed balancing weights. Post-split diagnostics are run on TRAIN -> VALIDATION only; TEST remains sealed. Primary length-control success is assessed with body word count only because that is the variable used to define the bins.
split_assignment_method: For each topic/year_month/length_bin, partition the minimum portal count as a shared balanced core across 60/20/20, then allocate each portal's surplus by largest remainder; articles sorted by body_words with seeded hash tie-break; split labels interleaved over length rank to preserve within-bin length distributions.
